extracted.name: Strawberries and Cream Trifle
extracted.description: This strawberry trifle with cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, frozen whipped topping, angel food cake, and berries is a 5-ingredient dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
3 pints fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
instruction_lines: Combine sweetened condensed milk, whipped topping, and cream cheese together in a bowl until smooth.

Place a layer of cake cubes in a large glass bowl. Top with a layer of strawberries; spread a layer of cream cheese mixture on top. Repeat layers until no ingredients remain, about 2 more times. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.
